name: Drink
description: The NPC drinks one alcoholic drink (ale, mead, wine and the like) from their own inventory. Use only when the NPC decides to have a drink, for example when offered one.
note: Living World only (MANTELLA_LIVING_WORLD=1). The NPC needs the drink in their inventory; the player can hand one over first. Each drink is remembered and makes the NPC merrier, then tipsy, then drunk, in speech and mood only.
prompt: If you decide to have a drink of ale, mead or wine that you are carrying, begin your response with '{key}:'.
